`interface IAudioBridge`<br/>
**Extends:** [`IBridge`](/reference/bridges/ibridge/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`AlAudioBridge`](/reference/base-openal/alaudiobridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.audio` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IAudioBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/audio/IAudioBridge.java)

The bridge that creates the audio sources on which JOID plays the sound of videos.

## Description

The backend registers it in `BridgeHandler.AUDIO`, unless it is built with `audio(false)`; without it, videos play without sound.
The video player calls it on the render thread.
[Create the bridge](/build/base-modules/openal/#create-the-bridge) plays the sound through the OpenAL context of the host, at the volume that the host gives each group.
